title: Promote user 'sayedbaquar' to admin and fix logout flow

requirements.text: Update backend role/permission logic so that the user whose profile.username is exactly "sayedbaquar" is treated as an admin (i.e., their stored UserProfile.role is #admin and AccessControl role is #admin), including when processing pending signups and when an admin attempts to update this user’s role.
acceptanceCriteria: If a user exists with username "sayedbaquar", calling the admin-only user listing shows this user with role "Admin" (Role.admin).
After pending signups are processed, a newly-signed-up user with username "sayedbaquar" receives admin permissions (passes isCallerAdmin()).
Attempting to set "sayedbaquar" to admin via the existing updateUserRole pathway results in admin permissions being granted (no silent downgrade due to allowlist checks).

requirements.text: Fix the logout flow so that logging out reliably ends the session and the UI/state no longer shows the prior user as authenticated (no stale profile/admin status/reports), using the existing full-cleanup logout approach.

quotes: logout function not working properly. Resolve it

acceptanceCriteria: Triggering logout results in the app returning to an unauthenticated state (no identity-bound data visible) after the logout flow completes.
After logging out from User A and logging in as User B, User A’s cached data (profile and reports) is not shown at any point.
Logout does not depend on editing immutable auth hook files (e.g., frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts); fixes are implemented via other frontend components/hooks that are allowed to change.

constraints: Do not edit files listed as immutable in SYSTEM_CONTEXT, including frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts and frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts.
Keep all Motoko logic in the single backend actor (backend/main.mo). Add backend/migration.mo only if an upgrade must preserve and transform existing stable state.
nonGoals: Implementing third-party authentication providers or non-Internet-Identity auth.
Adding new admin UI screens beyond what is necessary to ensure the admin assignment and logout behavior work correctly.
